entries.title: the leader worker topology elects and assigns across five fake agents
entries.detail: electleader elected a1 over the five fake agents with the workers w1, w2, the critic c1 and the verifier v1; assignwork sliced the two tasks across both workers in round robin order and collectresults gathered both outputs with no missing slice.

entries.title: the planner executor separation keeps drafting and execution in different agents
entries.detail: plannersplit separated the planner p1 from the executor e1, reportstep recorded the executor outcome with the repeated step id updating in place, and the same-agent split refused.

entries.title: the critic agent review loop closes on the reviewed output
entries.detail: requestreview routed the output of w1 to the critic c1, ackreview acknowledged it, applyreview closed the loop with the changes verdict and its issues, the answered request survived the sweep while the stalled one timed out.

entries.title: the verifier agent confirms the results before the completion
entries.detail: checkclaim marked the w1 claim pass with the re-read evidence and the w2 claim fail; the method grade refused the guess method and the failed slice reported failed instead of done.

entries.title: message passing delivers between every agent pair
entries.detail: sendmessage delivered the twenty direct messages of every ordered pair with four inbox, outbox and unread entries per agent, the drain acked four messages of a1, the broadcast reached every peer but the sender and the role addressed message reached the critic c1.

entries.title: the shared task queue hands out every task exactly once
entries.detail: the seven tasks of the shared queue were claimed exactly once each across the three workers (no task handed out twice), completed in place and the queue closed under the all policy with both lanes reporting.

entries.title: work stealing respects the lock protocol of the lanes
entries.detail: steal moved the indexing task to the idle worker w2 under the lane ownership that refuses the critic, the policy grade demanded the swarm approval, and the expired heartbeat returned the stolen task to the lane.

entries.title: the blackboard memory merges the concurrent writes of the agents
entries.detail: the two concurrent rowcount writes of w1 and w2 both stayed on the board with their authors, mergeresults folded them under the first rule with the value 42, the provenance of w1 and the conflict note naming both writers, and sharelesson landed the verified lesson on the findings section.

entries.title: the tab handoff between agents keeps the session state
entries.detail: preparehandoff, transferhandoff and resumehandoff moved the tab and the packaged session state between agents on every browser kind (chromium, firefox and safari) while the one tab one agent rule refused the contested transfer.

entries.title: the shared resource lock blocks the double writes
entries.detail: acquirelock refused the double write of w2 and the double hold of w1 while the shared kind admitted the second reader, releaselock refused the foreign holder and honored the right one, and expirelocks swept the expired lock back to the pool.

entries.title: the conflict detection catches the simultaneous edits
entries.detail: scanconflicts flagged the simultaneous edits of w1 and w2 on the same form selector with the suggested order w1, w2 while the writers of different origins stayed clean.

entries.title: the merge of results from parallel agents keeps the provenance
entries.detail: mergeresults folded the parallel results of w1 and w2 under the first, last, preferagent and fail rules with every merged value keeping its agent provenance, and swarmreport built the aggregate with both sources.

entries.title: the vote and consensus flow carries the quorum across the agents
entries.detail: openconsensus and castvote carried the round at the quorum of three yes votes and refused the late vote, consensusrecordof failed the complete no round with the dissenting reasons kept, and the quorum and weight grades held.

entries.title: the kill switch stops every agent at once
entries.detail: killall stopped all five agents with the switch engaged, engagekillswitch stopped the fleet records, cancelled every attributed run and cleared the shared queue in one call, and disarmkillswitch lifted the switch.

entries.title: pausing one agent leaves the others running
entries.detail: pauseone paused only w1 while a1, w2, c1 and v1 kept running, resumeone lifted the pause and refused the never-paused agent, the pause gate held and the heartbeat of w2 refreshed.

entries.title: the depth limit refuses the spawned sub agents past the ceiling
entries.detail: spawnsubagent built the lineage p1 → c1 → g1 with the child scope staying a subset of the parent, depthlimitof refused the depth two lineage under the ceiling of one, and the swarm spawn refused the same recursion.

entries.title: the escalation gate reaches the human from any agent
entries.detail: escalate lifted the stalled decision of w2 to the human, the hold blocked only the raising agent, resolveescalation landed the user decision and lifted the hold, and the terminal escalation refused the second decision.

entries.title: the review request flow routes between the agents of the shared origin
entries.detail: reviewrecordof moved the output of w1 to the critic c1 of the shared origin behind the policy gate that refuses the foreign origin, recordverdict landed the changes verdict beside the untouched original output, and the self review refused.

entries.title: the interleaved agent run replays for the audit
entries.detail: reconstructreplay rebuilt the run of w1 from the interleaved audit trail with the steps s1 recorded and s2, s4 done, rebuilt the failed paywall step of w2 as failed, runreplay captured the live failed step, and replayagentrun filtered the three w1 events from the merged stream.

entries.title: the comparison of the competing agent outputs names every difference
entries.detail: compareoutputs named the row count difference between w1 and w2, outputcompare aligned the fields field by field (title matching, rowcount conflicting, two missing) and the self comparison refused.

entries.title: the prioritized task lanes order the execution
entries.detail: prioritylaneof moved the sensitive task into the interactive lane and ordered the rest by lane priority with the round robin fallback, the lane change gate demanded the confirmation for the sensitive downgrade, and the queue claim picked the highest priority task first.

entries.title: the resource arbitration orders the contenders under contention
entries.detail: arbitrate ordered the three contenders under the priority, age and leader strategies, arbitrationcaseof granted the fastlane contender w2 under contention, releasecase released the case when the holder finished, and the verdict gate refused the out-of-scope origin.

entries.title: the worker scale decision follows the site load
entries.detail: scaleworkers grew the worker lane to the pending load inside the user bound and retired the idle workers, the load reports suggested a spawn on the idle origin and a pause on the throttled one, and the consent gate refused the unconsented scale.

entries.title: the per agent budget limits stop the right agent
entries.detail: the budget grant of w1 with its 1000 token and 5 step ceilings spent down to zero tokens with the overspend refusing at the ceiling, the over-budget w1 halted while the unbudgeted peer w2 and the in-budget usage kept running, so the budget stops the right agent alone.

entries.title: the per agent permission scopes gate the right kinds
entries.detail: the scope of w1 admitted its granted origin and namespace while refusing the outside origin, the browser namespace, the click kind outside its action kinds and the observer click, and the child scope kept its narrowing inside the parent grants without widening.

entries.title: the aggregate report merges every agent contribution
entries.detail: aggregatereport kept the conflicting contributions open, merged them under the user policy order that names w2, kept all three cells, and swarmreport folded the three agent contributions into two sections with every source named.

entries.title: the interleaved timeline orders the events of every agent
entries.detail: interleave ordered the concurrent actions of w1 and w2 into one timeline with the interactive lane first and every event keeping its lane, and interleavetimeline ordered the same stream by time with the handoff closing it.

entries.title: the lessons learned store deduplicates the entries
entries.detail: the lesson store kept one entry per lesson id while the rewrite carried its reuse count (no duplicate rows), lessonmatches served only the same-origin lesson and lessondecay retired the stale unreused entry while keeping the reused one.

entries.title: the coordination pool items 469 through 502 all map onto real modules
entries.detail: every pool item 469 through 502 maps onto one real exported function of the compiled agent.js or swarm.js modules (thirty four items, none missing), the shared cost split and the swarm overview answering beside them.

entries.title: the certified topology inventory exports from the agent registry snapshot
entries.detail: topologyinventoryof exported the five agent registry entries with their lanes and scenario families over the six certified scenarios of docs/agentscenarios.md, certifying the live leader worker topology of the five fake agents.
